entities.name: Wilhelt
entities.description: Vain lumberjack turned zombie warrior, obsessed with Gisa Cecani; she thinks his name is Wilham or Wilbur.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Ghoulcaller who rejected Wilhelt and raised an undead army.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City ruins where Wilhelt found Gisa and later besieged.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: Festival around which Wilhelt returned to Thraben.

events.summary: Wilhelt pledged his heart to Gisa on first sight; she yawned and walked away.
events.quote: He pledged his heart to her on the spot, which she promptly broke by yawning and walking away.

events.summary: Distracted by the rejection, Wilhelt died in a tree-chopping accident and rose as a ghoul.
Wilhelt found Gisa in the ruins of Thraben, then terrorized Innistrad raising an undead army as a wedding present.
events.quote: He terrorized the townships of Innistrad, raising an undead army in his wake to be his future wedding present.

events.summary: Wilhelt besieged Thraben with zombies and was defeated by Gisa's undead horde, then left.
events.quote: he besieged the city only to be summarily defeated by her superior undead horde

relations.quote: Wilhelt sought out Gisa to earn her affection
summarily defeated by her superior undead horde
